recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: karl the fog rolling over san francisco hills at fifteen degrees
kernels racing faster through automated research loops
open-source communities debating where machine intelligence belongs in the stack
tectonic tremors rippling through the indonesian archipelago
naval fleets shifting positions across distant waters
late summer dusk creeping past the golden gate sunset hour

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Steer a tiny sailboat through Karl the fog over SF bay — tap to flip wind and scoop glowing commit fragments before the mist swallows them.
composer-2.5-fast.touch_control: tap to flip wind direction between two lanes
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: Each 45-second run ends at sunrise with a tally of fragments rescued from the fog.
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: Fog banks thicken and drift faster; fragments appear in tighter gaps between walls.
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: watercolor mist over muted bay blues

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Rhythm-tap to fold neural kernel layers in sync with an auto-research loop — each beat shaves microseconds off a heat map until the matrix erupts in a 232x speed burst.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: Nailing the final bar triggers a satisfying multiplier flash and white-hot matrix collapse.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: BPM climbs each section; off-beat taps spawn latency penalty tiles.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: neon wireframe heat map on black

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Draw one-thumb deployment paths from a phone icon to spinning agent nodes — routes must thread through GitHub Action gates without crossing or lifting.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.touch_control: drag to sketch a continuous route
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: A clean path triggers a cascade of tiny agents shipping a micro-feature before the timer runs out.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: More gates spawn mid-draw and ambiguous fork nodes appear late in the round.

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Sort falling package tiles into contrib, non-free, and ai-contrib bins before a community vote timer expires — mis-sorted tiles spark gentle protest particles.
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: swipe packages left or right into bins
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: Hitting the vote threshold unlocks a harmonious merge animation and passing score.
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: Ambiguous dual-labeled packages arrive faster and overlap mid-fall.
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: terminal green glyphs on parchment scroll
